title: Tempura batter
preamble:
Ingredients:-
100g
Plain flour
40g
Cornflour
½
tsp Baking powder
½
tsp Salt
200ml
Ice cold sparkling water
Sunflower
oil for deep frying

100g
Plain flour
40g
Cornflour
½
tsp Baking powder
½
tsp Salt
200ml
Ice cold sparkling water
Sunflower
oil for deep frying

Method:-
Make the batter by adding all the dry ingredients to a bowl, lightly whisk the dry ingredients to get rid on any lumps and to mix everything together.
Add the water, whisking as you go, don’t worry about a few lumps, you want a consistency like single cream.
Use immediately.
Fry in vegetable oil at around 165 degC.
